# The library's agents

The agents of Agreements Demo Studio's library, by the name the app shows. A prompt that names one ("adapt the agent "Account Brief" …") means that spec: copy it, give the copy a new `id`, then change it. They belong to the fictional company "Fontara".

| Name | Spec | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Account Brief | `references/library/account-brief.spec.json` | A one-page customer brief for a QBR, from the signed agreements. |
| Address Splitter | `references/examples/address-splitter.spec.json` | No tools: turns one typed address into the four parts document templates take. |
| Approval Brief | `references/library/approval-brief.spec.json` | Gives an approval step something to read: a recommendation and the reasons. |
| Breach Notice Clock | `references/library/breach-notice-clock.spec.json` | Who must be told about a breach, by when and how, sorted by deadline. |
| Contract Intake Questioner | `references/library/contract-intake-questioner.spec.json` | Ask the User: a chat-only agent (Ask the User is refused in a workflow step) that asks one question at a time. |
| Contract System Verification | `references/library/contract-system-verification.spec.json` | The contract against the billing system: what drifted, and why. (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| Counterparty Brief Fontara copy | `references/library/counterparty-brief-fontara.spec.json` | A customized copy of a Featured (ready-to-deploy) agent: Duplicate, then Fontara's own instructions. |
| Relationship Next Action | `references/library/counterparty-brief.spec.json` | A relationship brief for an approver or account owner, from the agreement repository. |
| Data Use Rights Checker | `references/library/data-use-rights-checker.spec.json` | Can this vendor train on our data? From the clause. |
| Deal Desk CRM Check | `references/library/deal-desk-crm-check.spec.json` | Needs a connected Salesforce org: checks the paper against the CRM before it goes out. |
| DPA Coverage Check | `references/library/dpa-coverage-check.spec.json` | Is a signed DPA with this vendor on file? Yes, referenced only, no, or not needed. |
| Envelope Status Helper | `references/library/envelope-status-helper.spec.json` | Send Envelopes (an acting capability): status first, any change only after a yes in chat. |
| Execution Check | `references/library/execution-check.spec.json` | Was it signed properly? Four rules, from the signature page. (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| Exit Terms Reviewer | `references/library/exit-terms-reviewer.spec.json` | Can we leave this vendor, when, and at what cost? |
| Force Majeure Reader | `references/library/force-majeure-reader.spec.json` | Does this outage count as force majeure? From the clause text. |
| Insurance Certificate Checker | `references/library/insurance-certificate-checker.spec.json` | Lapsed, expiring, short or missing insurance certificates, per vendor. (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| Key Terms Summary | `references/library/key-terms-summary.spec.json` | A key-terms summary of one agreement, handed to a workflow as a Document output. |
| Legal Hold Builder | `references/library/legal-hold-builder.spec.json` | Who and what a legal hold must cover, from the agreements. |
| MFN Check | `references/library/mfn-check.spec.json` | Does this discount trigger a most-favoured-customer clause? |
| Milestone Acceptance Reader | `references/library/milestone-acceptance-reader.spec.json` | Delivered milestones: accepted, deemed accepted, or waiting — and billable? (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| MSA Positions Guide | `references/library/msa-positions-guide.spec.json` | Ask what Fontara will accept on an MSA clause before you negotiate. (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| NDA Deviation Review | `references/library/nda-deviation-review.spec.json` | Compares a counterparty NDA in Agreement Manager with Fontara's standard positions on term, governing law, non-solicitation and residuals, clause by clause. |
| NDA Quick Check | `references/examples/nda-quick-check.spec.json` | A fast NDA screen: can it be signed as is, or does it need counsel? |
| Notice Address Check | `references/library/notice-address-check.spec.json` | Would a notice under this agreement reach Fontara? (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| Obligation Extractor | `references/library/obligation-extractor.spec.json` | After signature: turns a signed agreement into the next obligation and its owner. |
| Pilot End Check | `references/library/pilot-end-check.spec.json` | When does this pilot end, and what happens if nobody acts? |
| Price Increase Checker | `references/library/price-increase-checker.spec.json` | Is this price increase allowed by the contract? |
| Renewal Notice Watcher | `references/examples/renewal-notice-watcher.spec.json` | Turns a renewal clause into an action and a cancel-by date for a scheduled renewal review. |
| Renewal Terms Chat | `references/library/renewal-terms-chat.spec.json` | A chat-only agent: renewal dates and notice periods from the agreement repository, asked in chat. |
| Request Intake Classifier | `references/library/request-intake-classifier.spec.json` | No tools: classifies a typed request so a workflow can branch on it. |
| Service Credit Checker | `references/library/service-credit-checker.spec.json` | What service credits can we claim, and by when? (its knowledge files are not here: add your own beside the copy, or drop `knowledge`) |
| Subprocessor Notice Checker | `references/library/subprocessor-notice-checker.spec.json` | Before a new sub-processor: who must consent, who must be told, and when. |
| Template Drafter | `references/library/template-drafter.spec.json` | Generate Documents (an acting capability): it lists and selects templates freely, and generates a document only after the person confirms. |
| Third Party Paper Triage | `references/examples/third-party-paper-triage.spec.json` | Classifies inbound third-party paper on a request and routes it — the agent behind a request-triggered triage workflow. |
| Usage Terms Reader | `references/library/usage-terms-reader.spec.json` | Usage commitments, tiers, overage and true-up, from the clause. |
| Vendor Risk Summary | `references/library/vendor-risk-summary.spec.json` | Feeds a vendor onboarding or renewal workflow with a risk tier and a security-review flag. |
